news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.02 (vs ₹0.037 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.02 (down from ₹0.037 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹34.0m (up 5.4% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.43m (down 35% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.2% (down from 12% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 40% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 7% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
